About us

Japanese precision, downtown Toronto

Seefu Hair Spadina is a Japanese hair salon in downtown Toronto, where stylists with precision cutting skills offer attentive service and careful, detailed work.

From a clean dry cut to balayage colour and perms, every appointment is shaped around your hair and the look you want.
